ideas.pitch: An edge-AI powered automated dustbin for the college campus that classifies and segregates wet, dry, and e-waste in real time using a camera module and microcontroller.
ideas.title: Smart Campus Waste Sorter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Best Hardware track with a physical build, following the winning pattern of practical robotics and sensor-based physical hacks.

ideas.pitch: An acoustic and radio mesh networking app that allows students and teachers to exchange notes and quizzes instantly without active internet connectivity.
ideas.title: MeshSync Offline Classroom
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns with the Best Software and Best Hardware tracks by solving local connectivity challenges using hardware-adjacent networking logic.

ideas.pitch: A telemetry and anomaly detection dashboard optimized for hackathon organizers to monitor submission spikes and API health during frantic submission hours.
ideas.title: Devfolio Hack-Metrics Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Appeals directly to Devfolio as a platform sponsor by improving the submission experience with robust time-series logging and anomaly checks.

ideas.pitch: A custom low-power IoT circuit using discrete timers and relays to monitor and cut off idle lab equipment power automatically.
ideas.title: Campus Green Energy Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Best Hardware track with custom circuit design and embedded firmware that showcases tangible engineering effort.

ideas.pitch: A high-fidelity Figma-to-code design verification tool that ensures strict component compliance for college event portals.
ideas.title: DesignSystem Companion
ideas.why_it_could_win: Competes specifically in the Best Design track by focusing on design systems, UI consistency, and developer-designer handoff automation.
